## Source-review corrections

Pushed `384111f936710bf75cb18707b8d64274772903d7` normally on unchanged frozen base `b8f5ea0b27c1641079b834b280cc28b067119b1d`; delta from `fee6d370c693bc9b39961a7662e8f5e23cc53530` touches only `internal/apps/homarr/target_gotify.go` and `docs/homarr-gotify-boundary.md`. No reference merge.

- Saved identity: verified the immutable Homarr v2.4.1 router and request schema. `integration.request` is a POST tRPC mutation carrying upstream `GET /current/user`; verification requires the selected integration ID/kind, `ok:true`, HTTP 200, the recorded numeric Gotify account ID and strict `admin:false`. Missing/malformed identity, another user or administrator is rejected before native data. Username redaction is respected; no account adoption, rotation or mutation.
- Notifications: existing read-only polling helper plus a 30-second context deadline requires native `integration.updatedAt` within this polling attempt. Ten-second cached results, missing/malformed/future timestamps and errors cannot establish readiness. Fresh authenticated empty arrays remain valid; message fields and the latest-100 cap remain checked. No sends or cache timestamp fabrication.

Passed with `GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false`: focused existing Gotify/Homarr tests, `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `go vet -tags e2e ./e2e/`, `go test ./...`, and race checks for TUI/Activity/Gotify/Homarr. `gofmt -l .`, `bash -n install.sh` and `git diff --check` are clean. Worktree clean.

Still draft: fresh standards/spec reviews are pending. Registration, assembly onto merged #309 (`6b82c55fb890c11a1388bd4e5a2f10b632ff4f7c`) and shared Stats normalization remain exclusively with the custodian. Existing fixtures do not exercise this unregistered descriptor. No new tests, files, code comments or dependencies; no Docker/browser/provider/account/message runtime actions or private-file access. This is source correction, not #282 native/rendered/lifecycle acceptance; the issue remains open.

Both fresh independent SOURCE reviews pass with zero findings at 384111f936710bf75cb18707b8d64274772903d7, fixed b8f5ea0b27c1641079b834b280cc28b067119b1d. Both P2s resolved: supported integration.request verifies Homarr saved authentication as the recorded non-admin account; genuine native Notifications timestamps must be fresh for the bounded cancellation-aware polling attempt. Account-local scope, latest-100 semantics, valid authenticated emptiness, reuse/collision recovery and private-secret boundaries remain intact. Source-only verdict: normalization/registration stays with the common custodian; no real account/message/native/rendered/shared-lifecycle proof or #282 completion is implied. Keep draft.
